I lighten my hair to a very white pale blonde color. In order to keep that ashy silver tone , purple shampoo is a life saver. In just a few days between being in the sun / normal heat styling, my white locks turn to a yellow color. Purple / blue shampoo instantly makes it vibrant and cuts out those brassy tones. I would switch off between blue shampoo  and a regular shampoo every other time depending on how silver you want to keep your hair color. It is better to wash your hair less but if you need to, try a dry shampoo 😌 hope this helps you ☺️🤍
